A Magic System Based On The Manipulation Of Sigils And Glyphs Which is More Likely To Be Learned By “Lower Class” Individuals. Wrighthing Takes A Lot Of Mental Fortitude, A Lot Of Constitution And A Lot Of Time. People Are Unlikely To Learn It Unless They Feel As Though They Have To. Oh It Is Also Dangerous.

 Its Practicality Is Evident Throughout All Of Society, For Example The Back of A Radio Used To Look Something Like This:  ![](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

Radios Still Have Wrighth But That Can Be Found On The Inside Instead Of exposed

  

One Of The Reasons It Has Become So Widespread Is Because It Is Only Able To Be Removed Or Altered By A Wrighther Of Equal Or Greater Prowess

  

Big Cities Have Wrighth That Detect Darkness And Float Orbs To Replace What Would Be Street-Lamps
